|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelscharm-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Charm.png]]). The later errata version is [[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012; the slip [[:File:VB8-00-Scoundrels_Charm.png]] and the Players Committee card image [[:File:VB8-L-scoundrelscharm-pre.gif]] print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top three cards of your Force Pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from opponent's just-drawn destiny.” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 29) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Scoundrel's Charm (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013, in every list) reads “the top 3 cards of your Force pile” and “subtract 1 from an opponent's just-drawn destiny” (the slip has “three”, “Force Pile”, “from opponent's”). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1281_35">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy from under Scoundrel's Luck on a scoundrel. Once per turn, may peek at the top 3 cards of your Force pile and take one into hand; reshuffle. Once per turn, may use 1 Force to add or subtract 1 from an opponent's just-drawn destiny.” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).
